title: Personal Loans Late Fees: Loan-Tenure Share
content:
## Rule

A loan-tenure share of a Personal Loans late fee applies, counting whole calendar months (whole calendar months being the difference in calendar months, less one when the later date's day of the month is smaller than the earlier date's) from the loan's funding date to the late fee's assessment date: 48 or more give 0.95; 24 to 47 give 0.97; fewer than 24 give no late-fee share.

The share multiplies the late-fee figure while it is still unrounded, before the late fee is held to no more than the unpaid portion of the installment and rounded to the cent once, at the end.

| Whole months from funding to the assessment date | Share |
|---|---|
| 48 or more | 0.95 |
| 24 to 47 | 0.97 |
| fewer than 24 | no share |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, funded on 20 January)

| Assessment date | Whole months | Share |
|---|---|---|
| 19 January two years later | 23 | no share |
| 20 January two years later | 24 | 0.97 |
| 19 January four years later | 47 | 0.97 |
| 20 January four years later | 48 | 0.95 |
